info.text: When a specialist is replying to call up from aircraft. Use the Identification of the aircraft initiating the call up. There are two methods to be used: » Use the full identification in reply to aircraft with similar sounding identifications. » For other aircraft, use the same identification the pilot used in initial call up; then use the correct identification after communications have been established.
EXAMPLE 1: "Jet Commander One Two Three Four Papa, Fort Worth Radio."
EXAMPLE 2: Initial Response "Cessna Triple Nickel Mickey Mouse, Fort Worth Radio." Subsequent Response "Cessna Triple Nickel Mickey Mouse, Fort Worth Radio."
